skill.name: notebooklm
skill.description: Query Google NotebookLM notebooks from Claude, Codex, or Claude Code with browser-based authentication, local notebook library management, and source-grounded answers.
skill.summary: Ask NotebookLM notebooks from local AI assistants with persistent browser auth and managed notebook links.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are documentation examples, standard Claude skill paths, or scoped local file operations. Confirmed risks include automatic setup commands, persistent Google session storage, anti-detection automation, and URL validation after navigation. No prompt-injection instructions were found.

remediation.issue: Automatic setup runs package and browser installation commands.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation before creating the virtual environment, installing requirements, or downloading Patchright browser components.

remediation.issue: Google browser storage is persisted to disk.
remediation.suggestion: Encrypt or permission-lock browser state, document cookie storage clearly, and keep the cleanup command prominent.

remediation.issue: Notebook URLs are opened before domain validation.
remediation.suggestion: Validate scheme and hostname before page.goto, and reject any URL that is not a NotebookLM notebook URL.
Remove evasion language, disclose browser automation plainly, and avoid bypassing service controls.

semantic_findings.title: Persistent Google Session Storage
semantic_findings.description: The skill saves browser storage state to disk and documents that browser cookies and sessions are stored locally. Compromise or accidental sharing of this directory could expose NotebookLM access.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The code directly saves cookies and localStorage with context.storage_state, and the skill documentation states browser cookies and sessions are stored.

semantic_findings.title: Anti-Detection Browser Automation
semantic_findings.description: The skill advertises human-like interaction to avoid detection and installs Patchright Chrome for fingerprinting reliability. This raises third-party service automation and policy concerns.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: README text explicitly says the automation avoids detection, and setup comments tie Chrome installation to browser fingerprinting and anti-detection behavior.

semantic_findings.title: Notebook URL Validated After Navigation
semantic_findings.description: The question script opens the supplied notebook URL before verifying that the browser landed on notebooklm.google.com. A malicious or mistaken URL can be loaded before rejection.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The code calls page.goto(notebook_url) before the NotebookLM domain regex check, so validation happens after navigation.

content.user_title: Query NotebookLM From Your AI Assistant
content.value_statement: Research answers can drift when they are not tied to source documents. This skill connects Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to NotebookLM notebooks for source-grounded responses.
actual_capabilities: Queries a NotebookLM notebook from a local Python browser automation script.
Stores NotebookLM notebook URLs with names, descriptions, topics, tags, and active selection.
Runs an interactive Google login flow and reuses saved browser state.
Searches, activates, lists, and removes notebooks from a local library file.
Adds follow-up reminders so the assistant can ask additional NotebookLM questions.
Creates a local virtual environment and installs required browser automation dependencies.
limitations: Requires a local Python environment, browser automation support, and access to Google NotebookLM.
Requires manual Google login before protected notebooks can be queried.
Stores browser session state locally, including cookies used for NotebookLM access.
Depends on NotebookLM page structure and Google account rate limits.

use_cases.title: Verify Technical Documentation
use_cases.description: Ask a NotebookLM notebook for answers grounded in uploaded manuals, API guides, or product documentation.

use_cases.title: Maintain Research Libraries
use_cases.description: Save multiple NotebookLM links with descriptions and topics so assistants can select the right notebook later.

use_cases.title: Answer Source-Based Questions During Coding
use_cases.description: Use Claude Code or Codex to query project notebooks while planning implementation details or checking constraints.

prompt_templates.title: Ask Active Notebook
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner question using the active notebook
prompt_templates.prompt: Use my active NotebookLM notebook to answer this question: [question]. Include only information supported by the notebook.

prompt_templates.title: Add Notebook
prompt_templates.scenario: Save a new NotebookLM link with useful metadata
prompt_templates.prompt: Add this NotebookLM URL to my library: [url]. First ask the notebook what it contains, then create a clear name and topics.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Source Details
prompt_templates.scenario: Ask follow-up questions until the answer is complete
prompt_templates.prompt: Query my [notebook id] notebook for [topic]. Ask follow-up questions until the answer covers requirements, caveats, and examples.

prompt_templates.title: Build Research Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Use NotebookLM to build a source-grounded brief on [decision]. Query relevant notebooks, identify gaps, and summarize evidence and uncertainties.

output_examples.input: What brake fluid and rear axle torque does my motorcycle manual specify?
output_examples.output: The assistant queries the workshop manual notebook and returns the specified fluid, torque value, and important cautions from the source.

output_examples.input: Add this NotebookLM URL to my library for future project research.
output_examples.output: The assistant discovers the notebook content, creates a descriptive library entry, adds topics, and confirms the saved notebook identifier.

output_examples.input: Check my API docs notebook for authentication requirements and error handling rules.
output_examples.output: The assistant asks NotebookLM targeted questions, follows up on missing details, and summarizes the supported requirements and open gaps.

best_practices: Use a dedicated Google account for automation and keep sensitive notebooks limited to needed documents.
Review NotebookLM answers before acting on maintenance, legal, medical, or financial details.
Clear saved browser state when switching accounts or after using shared machines.
anti_patterns: Do not store NotebookLM URLs for notebooks you are not authorized to access.
Do not rely on the first answer when the original request needs broader coverage.
Do not commit the local data directory, browser state, or authentication files to source control.

faq.question: Does this skill require a Google account?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses a visible browser login flow so NotebookLM can access notebooks available to that account.

faq.question: Where does the skill store notebook data?
faq.answer: It stores local library metadata and browser state in the skill data directory on the user machine.

faq.question: Can it upload documents to NotebookLM?
faq.answer: No. Users must add source documents to NotebookLM manually before this skill can query them.

faq.question: Does it work in web-only AI chat tools?
faq.answer: No. It needs local script execution, Python dependencies, and browser automation support.

faq.question: Are answers guaranteed to be correct?
faq.answer: No. NotebookLM grounds answers in notebook sources, but users should still verify important results.

faq.question: Why does it use a browser instead of an API?
faq.answer: NotebookLM does not provide a public API for this workflow, so the skill automates the web interface.
